newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony sets up management firm in China.
newsitem.headline: Sony sets up management firm in China.

text.p: Sony Corp said on Friday that had established a wholly owned subsidiary in Beijing to manage its marketing and after-sales services in China.
Sony (China) Ltd will be the company's regional headquarters in China and is part of Sony's strategy to expand its business there, the company said in a statement.
It said the unit was established last month. It gave no reason for the delay in making the announcement.

Sony said the new firm, capitalised at $30 million (3.3 billion yen), would support Sony's production facilities in China and its role would include ensuring the smooth introduction of technology and helping to promote local procurement.
Sony has been in the Chinese market since 1978.
In 1994, it began producing camcorders and optical pick-ups at Shanghai Suoguang Electronics Co Ltd, its first manufacturing facility in China.
